I have been using this for a number of projects, and been quite happy with it.


However, if you are working with a REST API, the way checkboxes are handled causes a problem. 


formParams() doesn't actually send the state of a checkbox, it sends a list of checked checkboxes. This means, if you uncheck all the checkboxes, nothing is sent. In a REST API, this means no change, so you are actually not able to save the changed state.


To work with a REST API, a true/false value should be returned.
